title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox analyst Rob Parker doubts Boston will make playoffs despite their hot streak since July.
Boston Red Sox hold the second A.L. wild-card spot with a 64-52 record, trailing Yankees by 1.5 games.
FanGraphs gives Red Sox a 96% chance of making playoffs, but Parker insists they will falter.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to leg swelling after being hit during Friday's game.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return to the lineup for Sunday’s game against the Athletics.
Abreu has contributed significantly this season with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, despite recent minor injuries.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox lose 7-3 to Athletics, ending a nine-game winning streak.
Jake Bennett allows four earned runs over 5.1 innings, leading to the defeat.
Red Sox hold second AL wild-card spot, 1.5 games behind Yankees.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is installing a new turf surface ahead of the Patriots' preseason game due to NFL protocols.
The current turf did not pass NFL laboratory testing since it lacks an 'E-layer' due to the stadium's 'stone dust' base.
Kraft Sports Group requested retesting of the turf, but the NFL's next procedural window is not until early 2027.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: The New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium.
Jack Harrison made his debut for the Revolution in the 55th minute without impacting the scoreline.
Goals by Guilherme and Agustin Resch secured Houston's victory, exploiting New England's defensive errors.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony, out since May with a wrist injury, is hitting off a pitching machine to train with higher velocities.
Adley Rutschman made a rehab appearance for Worcester Red Sox, catching five innings and demonstrating strong defensive skills.
Boston Red Sox are on a 9-game winning streak, with Anthony and Rutschman expected to bolster the lineup upon return.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix's August 2026 lineup includes 'Clueless', 'Eighth Grade', and 'Something's Gotta Give'.
Paramount+ features 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender', a 2026 continuation of the original series.
Boston.com staff recommends 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 and 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 for streaming.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an eight-foot-tall Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Since 1994, there have been 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England, according to BFRO, with several in New London County.
Biology professor Eva Garrett expressed skepticism, noting no scientific evidence supports the existence of a large ape resembling Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Meredith Goldstein shared a tribute to her late friend Margo Howard, an advice columnist and daughter of Ann Landers.
Margo, known for her direct advice, encouraged Meredith to move past grief and find happiness after loss.
Margo lived in Cambridge and authored the 'Dear Prudence' and 'Dear Margo' columns during her career.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle pitched six innings with 14 strikeouts in the Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
Boston Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, highlighted by a powerful offensive display with 15 hits.
New pitcher Raymond Burgos debuted with three hitless innings, as Red Sox reached .500 at Fenway for the season.
